questions.stem: A semicircular shape has a diameter of $10\text{ cm}$. What is the total perimeter of the semicircle? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: The curved part is half the circumference: $\frac{1}{2} \times \pi \times 10 = 5\pi\text{ cm}$. The straight edge is the diameter $= 10\text{ cm}$. Total perimeter $= 5\pi + 10\text{ cm}$.
